media.documented: Enabled Media Crate supplies visuals for audio lacking associated video. media.supersededIndependentPolicy: Before the recovered manual, Random also governed explicit Next. Prior random-Next passes established that independent behavior only. This source conflict supersedes that policy without erasing historical runs or claiming4.0.10 runtime parity.
media.independent: Explicit valid association wins even when fallback is off. Ordered shared cursor wraps; explicit Next always advances that cursor in crate order without consuming randomness. media.clipEnd: Selection never auto-advances at clip end. Caller owns loop/hold/transport and decode/error UI; no end-of-clip behavior is inferred from track-load fallback.
media.validation: Real named Blob/File with video/* MIME, or a recognized video extension when MIME is absent, generic or conflicting. Whole add batch validates before mutation; duplicate File references remain distinct explicitly added entries.

policy.distortion: Original static row warp plus Smooth Drive/Hard Clip/Foldback RGB transform; Drive/Character/Tone/depth have declared independent visual mappings.
policy.lifecycle: Opt-in off, disabled/zero effect, removal/reassignment/upstream topology changes, source asset/generation changes, backward render time, transport generation/direction/seek discontinuity, pause/stop clear Echo history immediately: no visual tail after bypass. policy.reducedMotion: Suppress all Echo trails and geometric Distortion warp; retain static distortion colour and observable semantic metadata. No generated flash or zoom.
policy.limitations: No exact Serato transfer/parameters/order/tail claim; channel knob FX, stems, Deck3/4 and Sampler links are not mapped. Audio graph/output is never mutated by this bridge.
